description: This file defines the TestRun class and various functions to manage and execute test tasks, including setup, teardown, and test phases, within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TestRun
classes.description: Manages the execution of test phases, including setup, teardown, and test running, with configuration and reporting.

methods.name: runTasks
methods.description: Executes a list of tasks with optional timeout and cancellation, then finalizes the test run.

methods.name: runTasksDeferCleanup
methods.description: Runs tasks with deferred cleanup, returning status and cleanup function.

methods.name: finishTaskRun
methods.description: Finalizes the test run status, calls reporter hooks, and returns the final status.

methods.name: createGlobalSetupTasks
methods.description: Creates setup tasks for global environment initialization.

methods.name: createRunTestsTasks
methods.description: Creates tasks to run test phases and reporting.

methods.name: createClearCacheTask
methods.description: Creates a task to clear the cache directory and plugin caches.

methods.name: createReportBeginTask
methods.description: Creates a task to signal the start of reporting.

methods.name: createPluginSetupTasks
methods.description: Creates setup tasks for registered plugins.

methods.name: createPluginBeginTask
methods.description: Creates a task to begin plugin execution.

methods.name: createGlobalSetupTask
methods.description: Creates a global setup task from a file.

methods.name: createGlobalTeardownTask
methods.description: Creates a global teardown task from a file.

methods.name: createRemoveOutputDirsTask
methods.description: Creates a task to remove output directories before tests.

methods.name: createListFilesTask
methods.description: Creates a task to load test files and build test suites.

methods.name: createLoadTask
methods.description: Creates a task to load test files with options for filtering and error handling.

methods.name: createApplyRebaselinesTask
methods.description: Creates a task to apply rebaselines for test results.

methods.name: createPhasesTask
methods.description: Creates phases for test execution based on project dependencies.

methods.name: createRunTestsTask
methods.description: Creates the main test execution task.

methods.name: createStartDevServerTask
methods.description: Creates a task to start a development server for testing.
